description: Wire snow_connector.py (built 2026-04-16) into approval_workflow. snow_connector.py receives ServiceNow inbound webhooks for MCP request tickets but is not yet connected to the approval pipeline. Must: (1) query mcp_submissions for pending tickets, (2) pass submission to snow_connector for SNOW OAuth authentication and ticket creation, (3) wire response back to approval_workflow. Must use write_service :8772 for all DB operations. Must NOT introduce direct HTTP between daemons. Integration test must verify webhook round-trip without blocking.
